Scoring multiple hits against a target within 3 seconds of each emits 3 damaging shockwaves from its location at the time of activation.

Shockwaves appear 0.285 seconds after scoring enough hits and have a 1 second delay between each pulse.

Each shockwave deals up to <pve 120 /> <pvp [20] /> damage over a 5 meter radius. Shockwaves deal 25% less damage if activated on <link Minor and Elite [#CombatantClassifications] /> PvE Combatants.

Shockwaves inherit Weapon Damage Buffs, the weapon's passive Kinetic Damage Bonus (10% on <primary/>Primary, 15% on <special/>Special), and its <link Combatant Damage Scaling [#CombatantScaling] />.

Hits Required for Activation:
• Submachine Guns: 14
• Pulse Rifles, Sidearms: #e${12-#d*3}
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: #e${6-#d*2}
• Sniper Rifles: #e${3-#d*1}

Further hits do not provide activation progress for 2? seconds after perk activation. Only one player can activate Kinetic Tremors on a target at a time (allegedly).
